# Notes: Agent Conventions

> **Audience:** Claude working in this directory.
> **Inherits from:** the scope's root `CLAUDE.md`.

`notes/_inbox/` is the raw-drop zone. When the user asks to process the inbox, groom each file into a dated note with inferred frontmatter and move it out of `_inbox/`.
